notice.text:
The model runs on your processor

A check on this computer found that its graphics chip gives wrong answers with the model, so ffwd uses your processor instead. This is slower, but the answers are right. On this computer, the first step takes about 24 seconds and each step after it about 5 seconds. A typical job spends about 32 seconds on the model before the video work starts. For big videos the desktop app, when it is out, will be faster.
